steps.text: Hello, little chefs! I'm Chef Maya. Today we're making crunchy vegetable fried rice!
Tie your hair and clean your hands. Ask our grown-up chef to help cook with the hot wok.
We have soft cooked rice, diced carrots, green peas, and savory seasoning sauce.
Tip the colourful crunchy vegetables right into the sizzling hot wok.
Stir-fry quickly with our spatula so the vegetables stay bright, sweet, and crisp.
Tumble in our fluffy steamed rice and drizzle a splash of savory sauce.
Toss and mix everything together until every grain of rice is golden and fragrant.
Dish our warm vegetable fried rice out onto a big plate. Bon appetit, little chefs!
